summary: Legend Biotech Corporation, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Current Report on Form 8-K) on October 13, 2026, announcing preliminary unaudited net trade sales of approximately $710 million for CARVYKTI for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, under its 2017 collaboration with Janssen. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. The sales figure is unverified and subject to completion of financial statements. Watch for final third-quarter revenue and gross profit in periodic reports.
